campuses.tagline: The flagship Stargate campus, built for Oracle and OpenAI

region.priceNote: EIA average industrial price in Texas, July 2026 (7.07¢/kWh). A regional average, not the campus's own contract.

facts.text: 1.2 GW campus of eight buildings, about 4 million square feet, with a 1.2 GW grid interconnection plus on-site batteries, solar and backup gas turbines.
Each building is designed for up to 50,000 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs on one network fabric.
Phase 1 (two buildings, 200+ MW) began construction in June 2024 and was expected to be energized in the first half of 2025.
Phase 1 went live on September 30, 2025, serving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for OpenAI; GB200 racks began arriving in June 2025.
Phase 2 (six buildings) began construction in March 2025, is expected in mid-2026, and topped out its final building in November 2025.

target.label: Targeted: energized in the first half of 2025

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.status: Not publicly confirmed live as of October 2026.

campuses.tagline: A $6 billion GPU cloud campus near Philadelphia

region.priceNote: EIA average industrial price in Pennsylvania, July 2026 (11.04¢/kWh). A regional average, not the campus's own contract.

facts.text: A $6 billion investment in a new data center in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, with room to grow up to 300 MW.

An estimated 100 MW project with capacity to expand to 300 MW, announced July 2025; built by a Turner–Wohlsen joint venture and co-developed by Chirisa Technology Parks and Machine Investment Group. Completion date not disclosed.

campuses.tagline: A 612-acre hyperscale campus, built to lease

region.priceNote: EIA average industrial price in Iowa, July 2026 (9.99¢/kWh). A regional average, not the campus's own contract.

facts.text: 612 acres in the Big Cedar Industrial Center, up to seven data center buildings, a planned $10 billion investment; the builder lists 420 MW with completion in December 2026.
Alliant Energy supplies power; the campus uses water-free cooling; at least two stages, with the first expected to be operational in 2026.
An analyst estimate puts the campus at about 1,133 MW of IT power by the end of 2027.

target.label: Analyst estimate: about 1,133 MW in total by late 2027
